name: Harvest Miracle Capital Berhad
overview: 今年公司出售了全资子公司 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. 的全部股权（RM51.6 million），并认购了 Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. 40% 的股权（总投资 RM4.4 million）。此外，公司多次提供财务援助。
overview_en: During the year, the company disposed of its entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. for RM51.6 million and subscribed for 40% of Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. for a total investment of RM4.4 million. The company also provided financial assistance on multiple occasions.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面进行了子公司股权出售和联营公司股权投资，并多次提供财务援助。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company disposed of a subsidiary, subscribed for shares in an associate, and provided financial assistance multiple times.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM40,000 现金认购 Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. 40% 股权，并提供 RM4,360,000 股东垫款，总投资 RM4,400,000。
actions.text_en: Subscribed for 40% of Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. for RM40,000 cash and provided a shareholder's advance of RM4,360,000, total investment RM4,400,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM51.6 million 出售全资子公司 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. 的全部股权。
actions.text_en: Disposed of the entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. for RM51.6 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售全资子公司 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd.，该公司及其子公司将不再为公司的子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of wholly-owned subsidiary Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd., which together with its subsidiary will cease to be a subsidiary of the company.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 认购 Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. 40% 股权，该公司成为联营公司。
model_changes.text_en: Subscribed for 40% equity interest in Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd., which became an associate company.
